nodes.statement: Remark. The existence of a unique p-adic unit root is a general result for unit root L-functions defined over the torus bb G_m^s. \]
Since 
\[
-w(v) + w(z) + \frac{1}{p^{m-1}} w(-z + p^m v) \geq \frac{p^{m-1} - 1}{p^{m-1}} w(z) + p w(v),

\] 
This proves the lemma.
